page_title: BOU 0-1 MCI | Bournemouth v Manchester City 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+6' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+3' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Ryan Christie is replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).
88' We are about to witness a subsitution. Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) for Milos Kerkez.

88' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
87' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) receives a yellow card for infringement.
87' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City win a free kick.
86' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
84' Substitution. Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) in, Mateo Kovacic out.
84' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
82' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
81' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
80' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Romain Faivre (Bournemouth) replaces Marcos Senesi.
78' A pass into the penalty area from Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is intercepted by the defence.
75' Substitution. Erling Haaland makes his way off the pitch and Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) comes on as his replacement.
75' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Neto.
72' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends the corner into the box, but Neto intercepts it and averts the threat.
72' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
71' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
70' This is a yellow card! Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
69' Substitution. Justin Kluivert will be replaced by Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
68' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Marcus Tavernier will be replaced by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth).
68' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
67' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) will take the corner.

67' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Corner kick. Bournemouth will have an opportunity.
66' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
65' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Manchester City force their opponents to concede a corner.
63' That's the end of the game for Matheus Nunes, who is replaced by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
60' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
59' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
58' Great teamplay by Bournemouth as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

55' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
54' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
54' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Manchester City are going to take it.
53' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) takes the corner kick, but Neto reads it well and stops the effort.

52' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester City. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

52' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Erling Haaland (Manchester City) inside the box. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
52' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Ederson.
51' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
48' One of the players from Bournemouth times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
47' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' The whistle blows and Jarred Gillett starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) steps up to send the ball in.

45+2' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. Bournemouth have a corner.
45+1' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
41' The resulting corner from Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
41' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
41' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
39' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the free kick from the edge of the box. His decent attempt goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
38' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
36' A pass from Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is intercepted by Neto and the move breaks down.
34' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
33' Manchester City are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
32' The ball has crossed the sideline. Manchester City are taking a throw-in.
29' Bournemouth couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Ederson (Manchester City) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
28' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle. Nathan Ake (Manchester City) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick has been awarded to Bournemouth.
27' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post.
25' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
24' 0 - 1 Goal! Phil Foden (Manchester City) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
23' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
20' The ball is cleared after Erling Haaland (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
19' Phil Foden (Manchester City) approaches the edge of the box with intent and shoots, but Neto rushes out to narrow the angle and smothers the ball. Good goalkeeping!
17' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
17' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
16' Neto (Bournemouth) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
14' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle after Adam Smith (Bournemouth) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a free kick to Manchester City in a dangerous position.
13' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
10' A corner kick by Bournemouth is thwarted by the well prepared Ederson (Manchester City).

10' A neat pass is well received by Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot. Bournemouth earn a corner.

9' Good team movement sets up Erling Haaland (Manchester City) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
6' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

5' Jarred Gillett blows for a foul after Nathan Ake (Manchester City) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Bournemouth, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
4' A pass by Rodri (Manchester City) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
3' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Bournemouth will kick the game off.
Jarred Gillett will supervise the game today.
